kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أعترف (form VIII)
# أَعْتَرِفُ (ʔaʕtarifu) /ʔaʕ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# أُعْتَرَفُ (ʔuʕtarafu) /ʔuʕ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# أَعْتَرِفَ (ʔaʕtarifa) /ʔaʕ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَرَفَ (iʕtarafa)
# أُعْتَرَفَ (ʔuʕtarafa) /ʔuʕ.ta.ra
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
